name: Scope 1 GHG Emissions
description: Direct greenhouse gas emissions from company-owned and controlled sources

name: Scope 2 GHG Emissions
description: Indirect GHG emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heat, or cooling

name: Scope 3 GHG Emissions
description: All other indirect GHG emissions in the value chain

name: Total Energy Consumption
description: Total energy consumed from all sources including fuel and electricity

name: Renewable Energy Percentage
description: Share of total energy consumption from renewable sources

name: Total Waste Generated
description: Total weight of waste generated, split by hazardous and non-hazardous

name: Total Employees
description: Total number of employees at end of reporting period

name: Female Employees Percentage
description: Percentage of total workforce that identifies as female

name: Female Board Members Percentage
description: Percentage of board of directors that identifies as female

name: Employee Turnover Rate
description: Percentage of employees who left the organization during the reporting period

name: Lost Time Injury Rate
description: Number of lost time injuries per 200,000 hours worked

name: Average Training Hours per Employee
description: Average hours of training and development per employee per year

name: Living Wage Commitment
description: Whether the company commits to paying a living wage to all employees

name: Board Independence Percentage
description: Percentage of board members who are independent non-executive directors

name: Anti-Corruption Policy
description: Whether the company has a formal, publicly available anti-corruption policy

name: Whistleblower Mechanism
description: Whether the company has a formal anonymous whistleblower reporting channel

name: ESG / Sustainability Report Published
description: Whether the company published a standalone ESG or sustainability report this year

name: Third-Party ESG Data Assurance
description: Whether ESG disclosures have been externally verified or assured

name: Pesticide Use
description: Total weight of pesticides applied per unit of crop area

name: Sustainably Sourced Raw Materials
description: Percentage of key raw materials sourced from certified sustainable suppliers

name: Food Safety Incidents
description: Number of recalls, withdrawals, or regulatory actions related to food safety

name: Total Land Use
description: Total area of land owned, leased, or managed for production

name: Operations in Water-Stressed Areas
description: Percentage of production facilities or land in high water-stress regions

name: Food Loss and Waste
description: Food waste as a percentage of total production volume

name: Recyclable or Reusable Packaging
description: Percentage of total packaging that is recyclable, reusable, or compostable

name: Animal Welfare Policy
description: Whether the company has a formal, publicly available animal welfare policy

name: Supplier Audit Coverage
description: Percentage of Tier 1 suppliers audited for social and environmental compliance

name: Conflict Minerals Policy
description: Whether the company has a formal policy on conflict minerals (3TG)

name: Products Taken Back for Recycling
description: Percentage of products recovered through take-back or recycling programs

name: Sustainable or Recycled Input Materials
description: Percentage of raw materials sourced from recycled or sustainably certified sources

name: Hazardous Waste Generated
description: Total weight of hazardous waste generated

name: Process Safety Incidents
description: Number of Tier 1 process safety incidents (releases, fires, explosions)

name: R&D Spend on Sustainable Chemistry
description: Percentage of R&D expenditure directed at green or sustainable chemistry products

name: Products with Safety Data Sheets
description: Percentage of products for which a Safety Data Sheet is publicly available

name: Total Water Withdrawal
description: Total volume of water drawn from all sources

name: Green Certified Buildings
description: Percentage of floor area with green building certification (LEED, BREEAM, etc.)

name: Construction Waste Diverted from Landfill
description: Percentage of construction and demolition waste recycled or reused

name: Methane Emissions Intensity
description: Methane emissions per unit of production (BOE or tonne of output)

name: Volume of Hydrocarbon Spills
description: Total volume of hydrocarbon spills to the environment

name: Flared Gas Volume
description: Total volume of natural gas flared at production sites

name: Mine Safety Incidents
description: Total recordable incident rate (TRIR) for mining operations

name: Financed Emissions
description: GHG emissions attributable to loans and investments in the portfolio

name: Climate Risk Exposed Portfolio
description: Percentage of loan or investment portfolio exposed to high climate risk sectors

name: Financial Inclusion Products
description: Number of products or programs designed for underserved or unbanked populations

name: Customer Data Security Breaches
description: Number of data breaches involving customer personal or financial data

name: Patient Safety Incidents
description: Number of reportable patient safety events or adverse incidents

name: Medical Device / Product Recalls
description: Number of product recalls or field safety corrective actions issued

name: Clinical Trial Transparency
description: Whether the company registers all trials and publishes results regardless of outcome

name: R&D Spend as % of Revenue
description: Research and development expenditure as a percentage of total revenue

name: Drug Pricing Transparency
description: Whether the company publicly discloses its methodology for setting drug prices

name: Products Available in Low-Income Markets
description: Percentage of product portfolio available in least-developed or low-income countries

name: Customer Data Breaches
description: Number of data breaches or cybersecurity incidents involving customer data

name: Product Energy Efficiency Improvement
description: Year-over-year improvement in energy efficiency of flagship products

name: E-Waste Recycled
description: Weight of electronic waste recovered and recycled through take-back programs

name: Fleet Fuel Efficiency
description: Average fuel efficiency of the operated vehicle or aircraft fleet

name: NOx and SOx Emissions
description: Total nitrogen and sulphur oxide emissions from operations

name: Safety Incidents per Million Miles
description: Number of reportable safety incidents per million miles/kilometres operated

name: Electric / Low-Emission Vehicles in Fleet
description: Percentage of fleet that is fully electric or meets low-emission standards

name: Grid Reliability — SAIDI
description: System Average Interruption Duration Index: average outage duration per customer per year

name: Transmission and Distribution Losses
description: Percentage of electricity lost in transmission and distribution networks

name: Data Privacy Complaints
description: Number of substantiated complaints received from customers regarding data privacy

name: Network Uptime / Availability
description: Percentage of time the core network was available during the reporting period

name: Digital Inclusion Programs
description: Number of active programs improving connectivity or digital literacy for underserved communities

name: Diverse Supplier Spend
description: Percentage of procurement spend with minority, women, or veteran-owned businesses

name: Employee Benefits Coverage
description: Percentage of full-time employees covered by health, retirement, and wellness benefits

name: Product Safety Incidents and Recalls
description: Number of product recalls or safety incidents reported to regulators

name: Sustainable Packaging
description: Percentage of total packaging weight that meets sustainability criteria

name: Tier 1 Supplier Transparency
description: Percentage of Tier 1 suppliers publicly disclosed on the company website

name: Water Treatment Capacity
description: Maximum daily water treatment or supply capacity

name: B Corp Workers Score
description: B Impact Assessment workers pillar score, normalised to 0-100

name: B Corp Governance Score
description: B Impact Assessment governance pillar score, normalised to 0-100

name: B Corp Customers Score
description: B Impact Assessment customers pillar score, normalised to 0-100

name: B Corp Environment Score
description: B Impact Assessment environment pillar score, normalised to 0-100

name: Upright SDG 8 Decent Work Alignment
description: Degree of alignment with SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth)

name: Data Centre Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE)
description: Average PUE across all owned and operated data centres (lower is better)

name: Upright Scarce Natural Resources Impact
description: Scarce natural resources consumption cost in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright SDG 5 Gender Equality Alignment
description: Degree of alignment with SDG 5 (Gender Equality)

name: Sustainalytics Environment Score
description: Environmental sub-score from Sustainalytics

name: Upright Non-GHG Air Pollution Cost
description: Non-GHG air pollution impact in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright Waste Impact
description: Waste generation impact cost in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Sustainalytics Controversy Level
description: Highest controversy level (1–5) flagged by Sustainalytics

name: Upright SDG 13 Climate Action Alignment
description: Degree of alignment with SDG 13 (Climate Action)

name: Upright GHG Emissions Cost
description: GHG emissions impact cost in cents per dollar of revenue (harm)

name: Upright Equality & Human Rights Benefit
description: Equality and human rights benefit in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Sustainalytics Governance Score
description: Governance sub-score from Sustainalytics

name: Sustainalytics Total ESG Risk Score
description: Overall ESG risk score from Sustainalytics via Yahoo Finance (lower = less risk)

name: Upright Biodiversity Impact
description: Biodiversity loss impact in cents per dollar of revenue

name: CEO-to-Median Worker Pay Ratio
description: Ratio of CEO total compensation to median employee total compensation

name: Upright Jobs Benefit
description: Jobs created benefit in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright GHG Emissions Benefit
description: GHG emissions avoided — benefit in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright Equality & Human Rights Cost
description: Equality and human rights harm in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Building Energy Intensity
description: Average energy consumption per square metre of managed floor area

name: Upright Taxes Benefit
description: Tax contribution benefit in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright Net Impact Percentile
description: Percentile rank among 10,000+ companies (higher = more positive impact)

name: Land Disturbed vs Reclaimed Ratio
description: Ratio of land disturbed by operations to land successfully reclaimed

name: Sustainalytics Social Score
description: Social sub-score from Sustainalytics

name: Upright Physical Health Cost
description: Physical disease impact cost in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright Physical Health Benefit
description: Physical health benefit in cents per dollar of revenue

name: Upright Net Impact Ratio
description: Net societal impact per dollar of revenue (negative = net harm, positive = net benefit)

name: B Corp Community Score
description: B Impact Assessment community pillar score, normalised to 0-100

name: B Corp Overall Impact Score
description: Overall B Impact Assessment score, normalised to 0-100

name: Environmental Score
description: Estimated environmental pillar score (0–100)

name: Social Score
description: Estimated social pillar score (0–100)

name: Governance Score
description: Estimated governance pillar score (0–100)

name: ESG Summary
description: Plain-English ESG performance summary generated by the explainability agent.

name: Annual Revenue
description: Total annual revenue — context metric used as the denominator for emission/resource intensity (carbon-per-revenue)
